text: A controller battery whose low state is indicated by an incorrect date and clock in the controller log. It keeps the clock and has a long shelf life of up to 10 years. A wrong clock makes the log harder to use because time stamps no longer match what happened in the plant.

evidence.quote: The CMOS battery that keeps the clock has a long shelf life of up to 10 years.
A wrong clock also makes the log harder to use, because the time stamps no longer match what happened in the plant.

text: A joint seal that must be replaced on all robot joints if wear or damage is detected on any single ring. On a UR arm, these outside seals keep dirt and fluids out of the joints.

evidence.quote: On a UR arm, the outside seals are called flat rings.
Seals keep dirt and fluids out of the joints.

text: A solid-state switching device whose high off-state leakage current exceeding 1 mA makes it unsuitable as an input for PLCs. Some sensors switch AC with this device, though a switched-off TRIAC still lets a little current through.

evidence.quote: Some sensors switch AC with a solid-state device called a TRIAC.
A switched-off TRIAC still lets a little current through.

text: Maintenance done after equipment has failed or stopped. In this run-to-failure approach, equipment is run until it fails, whereas preventive work is done on schedule whether or not the machine shows a problem.

evidence.quote: The simplest approach is run-to-failure servicing: run equipment until it fails.
The work is done on schedule whether or not the machine shows a problem.

text: A multi-stage edge detection algorithm that uses Gaussian smoothing, intensity gradients, non-maximum suppression, and hysteresis thresholding to find thin, robust boundaries. Under hysteresis thresholding, a pixel below the lower threshold is rejected. A pixel between the two thresholds is kept only if it is connected to a pixel above the upper threshold.

evidence.quote: A pixel below the lower threshold is rejected, and a pixel between the two thresholds is kept only if it is connected to a pixel above the upper threshold.

text: A processor mechanism that halts normal program execution immediately when an electrical pin changes state, to run an Interrupt Service Routine (ISR). An ISR is a short routine that updates the count before the processor resumes the main program.

evidence.quote: When the chosen edge occurs on an interrupt-capable pin, the processor pauses the main program, runs a short Interrupt Service Routine (ISR) that updates the count, and then resumes.

text: A second-order Runge-Kutta numerical integration technique evaluating robot heading at the midpoint of a time interval to improve path curvature accuracy. It evaluates the trigonometry at the average heading halfway through the step, as used in the ROS 2 driver for the TurtleBot3 teaching robot.

evidence.quote: Midpoint integration evaluates the trigonometry at the average heading halfway through the step, and the ROS 2 driver for the TurtleBot3 teaching robot uses exactly this form

text: A high-efficiency dual full-bridge motor driver IC using power MOSFETs with low on-resistance (0.5 ohms), generating minimal heat without requiring a heatsink. This driver is an intermediate power stage that takes low-current control signals from the microcontroller and switches the much larger motor current from a separate supply.

evidence.quote: This is an intermediate power stage that takes low-current control signals from the microcontroller and switches the much larger motor current from a separate supply.

text: KUKA Robot Language, the proprietary, Pascal-like programming language used to program KUKA industrial manipulators. In KRL, each program is made of two files with the same name. Keeping data apart from logic means a taught point can be changed without editing the motion code.

evidence.quote: each program is made of two files with the same name.
Keeping data apart from logic means a taught point can be changed without editing the motion code.

text: The Python-like text scripting language that executes on Universal Robots controllers for motion, I/O, and real-time threads. For example, a thread can keep watching a sensor input while the main program moves the arm.

evidence.quote: A thread can, for example, keep watching a sensor input while the main program moves the arm.

text: The rate at which a PWM square wave completes full ON/OFF cycles, measured in Hertz (Hz). Typical values are 490 Hz or 980 Hz on an Uno by default, or ultrasonic (above 20 kHz) with a reconfigured timer.

evidence.quote: 490 Hz or 980 Hz on an Uno by default, or ultrasonic (above 20 kHz) with a reconfigured timer

text: The difference (residual) between an actual sensor measurement and the measurement predicted by the system state model. For example, PX4's flight-controller EKF runs innovation consistency checks and ignores a sensor reading whose innovation is too large compared with the predicted uncertainty.

evidence.quote: PX4's flight-controller EKF performs innovation consistency checks and ignores a sensor reading whose innovation is too large compared with the predicted uncertainty.
